remarks: Sun-filled rental in a charming farmhouse just north of downtown Westport! With a sparkling recently added new kitchen and gorgeous restored antique floors, this sun-filled second floor rental is a stylish and happy place to be. With central air AND a garage, this checks all the boxes. Set in lovely neighborhood close to town, this spacious 980SF rental comprises the entire second floor of this pretty home. Large living room, new eat-in kitchen, large bedroom with office alcove. Washer and dryer are conveniently located right in the unit. This charming apartment is a welcome place to call home, just over a mile's stroll to Westport's lively downtown shops and restaurants. School bus stops right at the house -- as does the shuttle to the train, making for an easy NYC commute! Landlord pays landscaping, water and trash removal!
